correction.statement: Loki 3.0.0 removes `-tsdb.shipper.shared-store.key-prefix`. Operators who set it to something other than `index/` must set `path_prefix` in every existing tsdb period config to that earlier value.

consequence.statement: Loki 3.0.0 removes `-tsdb.shipper.shared-store.key-prefix` and its YAML setting. The index path prefix is now set by `path_prefix` under the `index` key in period_config. If the removed setting was configured to a value other than `index/`, all existing period configs that use `tsdb` as the index must have `path_prefix` set to the earlier value.
consequence.remediation: Before upgrading, remove `-tsdb.shipper.shared-store.key-prefix` (or its YAML setting). In every existing period config that uses `tsdb` as the index, set `index.path_prefix` to the value the flag had.
